data.headline: Cheap no-name projector: inflated specs and early failure; buy Epson instead

reasons.text: 12,000 lumen at €90 is not ANSI brightness; measured output is typically a fraction of the claimed figure, making the spec misleading.
A first-hand failure report shows pixelation after only 4 weeks of hobby use in a rebranded model from the same clone family.
The product belongs to a clone family of throwaway brands (XGODI, XGODY, Etokfoks, ELEPHAS) with no established support or spare parts.
Despite the low upfront price, estimated cost per year is about €335, far worse than an Epson alternative at roughly €103 per year.
The 4.5-star average and 5,600 reviews are likely driven by low-cost impulse buys, not long-term reliability evidence.
